svg.title: How hidebox works
svg.desc: Four parts. Your browser locks every file: it sees your files, never who opened them. Our server gets scrambled noise. Never the key. It sees a padded size and the hour, never names, keys or contents. Whoever has the link opens it by its rule: they see the shared file, never your other files. When a file leaves your drive, we write that on the Tari chain, for anyone to check: the chain sees a payment and its fee, never the amount, the owner or the key. The key hides in the link, after the # sign.
